units.text: Sweden’s estimated population on July 1, 2024, was stated as 10,673,669 by one source.

judgement.reason: The passages state Sweden's 2024 population was 10,673,669, but they do not specify it is an estimate for July 1, 2024.

units.text: Another source estimated Sweden’s population in 2024 as 10,606,999.

judgement.reason: The passage states Sweden counted 10,606,999 inhabitants as of 2024, directly supporting the statement.
